method: Seed: NAP public e-shop list (265 unique own-domain shops across 6 categories). Discovery in that list says nothing about compliance. Official data: NAP declaration and VIES, queried live.
wording: Findings describe observed disclosure shortfalls on the public website on the check date. They are not a legal determination.
